title: Data Scientist - SC Cleared
description:
Data Scientist - SC Cleared

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Data Scientist to support a high-profile government programme focused on improving data matching capabilities, analytical processes and operational performance.

You'll join an established technical team, working on the development, optimisation and refinement of a sophisticated matching engine.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, refine and optimise data matching and entity resolution processes.
  • Work hands-on with Elasticsearch, including querying, data retrieval and performance optimisation.
  • Develop and maintain Python-based data processing and analytical solutions.
  • Support the deployment and operation of applications within Kubernetes environments.
  • Use Bash scripting to automate workflows, troubleshoot issues and support operational processes.
  • Investigate data quality issues, improve matching accuracy and identify opportunities for operational efficiencies.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong AWS experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Python and production data processing.
  • Hands-on Elasticsearch experience, ideally including implementation, querying and optimisation.
  • Practical experience working with Kubernetes and Bash.
  • Experience with entity resolution, record linkage, data matching or complex data integration.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with complex datasets.
  • Ability to operate independently and contribute quickly within an established engineering team.
  • Active UK SC security clearance.
